QF.id: IV Clearing Settlement and Risk Management_32

question.text: Which of the following products is excluded from SEBI's interoperability framework among clearing corporations?

explanation.text: The Logic: SEBI's interoperability framework applies to exchange-traded products with the exception of commodity derivatives. The framework has been extended to the currency derivatives segment, which includes Exchange Traded Interest Rate Derivatives (ETIRD). The Trap: Equity cash, equity derivatives and currency derivatives are all covered by interoperability. Only commodity derivatives are carved out from the framework. Note: Because ETIRD is part of the currency derivatives segment, interoperability is available for interest rate derivative products too.
